question: On one 20 x 12 mm known-text window of PHerc0841 (the w00 surface), do two blind humans still see rows when part of the field is displaced onto a neighbouring sheet (dispersed or clustered) or cut out as holes, where the AI agent readers did not?
window: PHerc0841 known-text window W on the organizers' w00 mesh, 20 x 11.7 mm, read with the organizers' canonical 2.4 um ink model; tiles 800 px on the long side

levels.L100: undamaged w00 surface over the window (readable control), render offset +0
levels.L85: 15 % of the field hopped (dispersed ~1 mm patches moved off w00 onto the nearest public m7 sheet-prediction run; mostly less than one sheet deep), +0
levels.L70: 30 % of the field hopped, dispersed ~1 mm patches (same hop law as L85), +0
levels.L55: 45 % of the field hopped, dispersed ~1 mm patches (same hop law), +0
levels.C85: 15 % of the field hopped in clustered clumps (~17 mm2), +0
levels.C70: 30 % of the field hopped in clustered clumps, read at a -22-layer render offset (about -52.9 um; the depth an earlier max-99th-percentile pick chose)
levels.H70: 30 % of the field cut out as clustered holes (black), +0
levels.H50: 50 % of the field cut out as clustered holes (black), +0

pictures.calib: calibration: a known-rows ink map of another public fragment's known text (not this window), a picture both raters had rated before
pictures.calib_blank: the calibration map in the wrong layer order (wrong-order blank)

page_order: hardest first, shuffled inside blocks (numpy default_rng 20261002): A = L55, H50, C70, L70, H70 + their blanks; B = L85, C85 + blanks; C = L100 + blank, calibration, calibration blank
doses_note: every dose is built from w00 (added on top of w00's own errors): conservative; hops are displacements onto the nearest public m7 run, mostly 50-250 um and often less than one sheet deep (the 2.4 um reader still saw part of the true text in the hop pixels: label AUC 0.65 / 0.79 vs blank ~0.5)

rule.valid_rater: calibration called rows and at most 1 of the 9 blanks (8 level blanks + the calibration blank) called rows
rule.masked_call: a rater's call on a level counts only if that level's own blank is not rows for him; a masked call counts as not rows (so that level can be at most 'split')
rule.per_level: 'reads for humans' if both valid raters say rows (unmasked); 'split' if exactly one does; 'does not read' if neither
rule.agents_per_level: a level 'reads for agents' if >= 2 of its valid agent readers said rows

decision.(i): H70 reads for humans -> holes at ~30 % are tolerable to human eyes
decision.(ii): C70 or L70 reads for humans and not for agents -> the wrong-sheet bar relaxes toward ~30 % for human reading; a level that reads for both humans and agents does not fire (ii) and is reported as a contradiction
decision.(iii): none of H70 / C70 / L70 reads for humans -> the agents' bar (>= ~85 % on the right sheet) stands for humans

rule.both_can_fire: (i) and (ii) can both fire; L100, L85, C85, L55, H50 are descriptive
rule.stage0: both raters must be valid (else unscorable: INCONCLUSIVE)

scope: rows visible, not the right text read: displaced patches carry the neighbouring sheet's surface; one picture per level, n = 2 raters, one window; the second rater may have seen the clean version of the same text a minute before rating (rating order between this page and depth_w unproven)

stage0.note: both rating files sha-pinned before scoring; 18/18 answers each; both raters valid
